subject: Establishing Billing Sender, Invoice Delivery Flow, and VAT Reverse Charge — Action Items
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@acmedata.co.uk>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:58:00 +0000
Subject: Establishing Billing Sender, Invoice Delivery Flow, and VAT Reverse Charge — Action Items

Hi Oliver,

Thanks for the trial usage last quarter — excited to have Acme on board. Before our first invoice goes out, a couple of quick coordination items so we set up delivery and tax treatment correctly: 

1) Who should be the invoice "sender" on the PDF (the name that appears in the From/Bill-To line)? We can set the invoice originator to Redwood Inference (default), or if you prefer your internal accounting to receive invoices showing a specific bill-to alias we can configure that.

2) Delivery channel: we support three delivery methods — portal push (recommended), SFTP push (secure batch), and email PDF copies. Which do you prefer as the primary channel? We can also set email copies to a separate AP address if needed.

3) VAT / reverse-charge: you previously mentioned this may be reverse-charge eligible. Please confirm Acme's VAT number and whether you require “reverse charge” wording on invoices or a specific VAT appendix. If you can attach a VAT certificate or a short confirmation from your tax team that would be ideal.

4) PO/Remittance: do you require a PO number on each invoice? If yes, will it be provided per invoice or monthly?

If you can reply with the preferred delivery method, the billing contact (name + email), VAT number, and PO requirements, we’ll set everything up and send a confirmation prior to the first invoice. Timeline: assuming we receive confirmation today, we can enable portal access and have the first invoice scheduled for 2026-09-30.

Thanks — I’ll loop in our billing ops to make the changes once you confirm.

Best,

— Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Establishing Billing Sender, Invoice Delivery Flow, and VAT Reverse Charge — Action Items

Hi Lauren,

Thanks — quick answers below from the finance team: 

- Invoice sender: Please keep Redwood Inference as the originator on the PDF (that’s what our systems expect).
- Delivery channel: Portal push is preferred. Please also send a PDF copy to ap-team@acmedata.co.uk (AP Team).
- VAT: Acme Data Ltd VAT number is GB123456789. This is a standard reverse-charge situation for services; we need the invoice to include the line: “Reverse charge — VAT exempt under Article 44 of the VAT Act” (or equivalent). I’m attaching our VAT certificate for your records.
- PO: We will issue a monthly consolidated PO number for September onward (one PO per month). Please include the PO on the invoice header.

If you can confirm when the portal invite goes out and that ap-team@acmedata.co.uk will be CC’d, we’ll mark this as green.

Cheers,
Oliver

Thanks for forwarding, Lauren — summary and ops plan below.

Summary of Acme response (key points):
- Keep Redwood Inference as invoice sender.
- Primary delivery: Portal push; send PDF copy to ap-team@acmedata.co.uk.
- VAT: GB123456789; treat as reverse-charge, include required wording.
- PO: monthly consolidated PO; include PO number on header.

Requested actions (ops):
1) Portal: Create billing contact for Acme with role "Invoice Recipient" and invite ap-team@acmedata.co.uk. Set monthly invoice schedule (end-of-month).
2) Invoice template: Add VAT reverse-charge clause (include exact copy below) and a field for the monthly PO number.
3) Delivery fallback: Configure SFTP push as fallback in case portal onboarding is delayed; route to sftp.acme.payments (credential exchange via encrypted token).
4) Archival/tax evidence: Store the provided VAT certificate in contract evidence (linking to HubSpot contact-129384).

Exact clause to include on invoice: "Reverse charge — customer liable for VAT under UK domestic reverse charge rules (VAT number provided: GB123456789)."

Marcus — can you:
- Schedule the portal invite and confirm the invite links & roles?
- Patch the template with the reverse-charge clause and PO field?

Monica — once Marcus confirms, can you perform a dry run: issue a sample PDF (to ap-team@acmedata.co.uk) and validate PO field visibility?

I’ll create the SFTP token and share credentials over the secure channel if needed.

Vivek
Sr. Manager, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
